correctness.rationale: Clifford theory reduces nonlinear irreducibles to two-element orbits of linear characters of the cyclic index-two subgroup. For D, Q, and SD only the trivial and order-two cyclic characters are invariant, yielding four linears and multiplicity 2^(j-2) at nonlinear codegree 2^j. For M exactly the even-index cyclic characters are invariant; its abelianization is C_{2^(m-2)} x C_2 and every odd-index character is faithful. The packaged checker verifies the formulas and degree-squared identities for 4<=m<=12.

value.rationale: The four nonabelian 2-group families with a cyclic subgroup of index two are a classical complete structural test class. The theorem determines the pseudo-algebra on the entire class, showing a clean information boundary: order is recovered, the modular family is detected, but the three maximal-class families collapse completely.
